newsitem.title: UK: Weak UK FTSE index tethered at 4,000 before data.
newsitem.headline: Weak UK FTSE index tethered at 4,000 before data.

text.p: The UK stock market set record highs on Thursday but failed to live up to its early promise and retreated back to the key 4,000 level by the close as investors played safe ahead of Friday's key U.S. employment data.

The FTSE 100 index, which had set a record 4,024.3 points on the back of strong gilts prices and an influx of cash, turned tail as futures prices declined and closed the day at 4,000 points, down 15.1 points on the day.
"We'd assumed this morning the FTSE was good for another 15 or 20 points. But people got a bit wary, mindful of the market's recent strength and tomorrow's U.S. data," one dealer said.
